Software Catalog · Software Catalog · discovery

The portal finds the file and keeps the catalog up to date by itself

How the file reaches the catalog

  • Source: catalog-info.yaml in the repository
  • Discovery: the portal scans the GitHub organization
  • Refresh: reprocessed on a schedule, no manual edits
Catálogo de software · Catálogo de software · descoberta

O portal encontra o arquivo e mantém o catálogo em dia sozinho

Como o arquivo chega ao catálogo

  • Origem: catalog-info.yaml no repositório
  • Descoberta: o portal varre a organização no GitHub
  • Atualização: reprocessado em intervalos, sem edição manual

App Declaration · App Declaration · resources

The app declares what it needs to run, starting with a postgres database: the type, not the product

Declaração da app · Declaração da app · recursos

A app declara do que precisa para rodar, começando por um banco postgres: o tipo, não o produto

app-spec.yaml
1apiVersion: score.dev/v1b123metadata:4  name: seat-selection56resources:7  db:8    type: postgres9  dns:10    type: dns11  route:12    type: route13    params:14      host: ${resources.dns.host}15      path: /16      port: 801718containers:19  api:20    image: .21    variables:22      DATABASE_HOST: ${resources.db.host}23      DATABASE_NAME: ${resources.db.name}24      DATABASE_USER: ${resources.db.username}25      DATABASE_PASSWORD: ${resources.db.password}2627service:28  ports:29    http:30      port: 8031      targetPort: 8080

App Declaration · App Declaration · what is left out

No line says where, in which cloud, or with which tool

What the spec leaves out

  • Where: no cluster, no region
  • Cloud: no Azure, no AWS
  • Tool: no Helm, no Terraform
Declaração da app · Declaração da app · o que fica de fora

Nenhuma linha diz onde, em qual nuvem, nem com qual ferramenta

O que a spec deixa de fora

  • Onde: nem cluster, nem região
  • Nuvem: nem Azure, nem AWS
  • Ferramenta: nem Helm, nem Terraform
Golden Paths · Golden Paths

The golden path creates the repository, the declaration and the spec at once

Golden Paths

Source: platformengineering.org/platform-tooling · planes as parallel layers; the journey order is ours

Golden paths · Golden paths

O golden path cria o repo, a declaração e a spec de uma vez

Golden Paths

Fonte: platformengineering.org/platform-tooling · planes as parallel layers; the journey order is ours

Golden Paths · Golden Paths · why developers choose it

The right way has to be the easiest: that is what makes the developer choose the golden path

Why developers choose it

  • What: the supported path for a recurring task
  • Rule: the easy way is the right way
Golden paths · Golden paths · por que o dev o escolhe

O caminho certo precisa ser o mais fácil: é isso que faz o dev escolher o golden path

Por que o dev o escolhe

  • O quê: o caminho suportado para uma tarefa recorrente
  • Regra: o jeito fácil é o jeito certo
Golden Paths · Golden Paths · how it guides

The golden path guides without trapping: it is optional and composes with others

How it guides

  • Shape: optional and composable
  • Risk: a golden cage breeds shadow platforms
Golden paths · Golden paths · como ele guia

O golden path guia sem prender: é opcional e se compõe com outros

Como ele guia

  • Forma: opcional e composável
  • Risco: uma golden cage gera shadow platforms
Golden Paths · Golden Paths · what it creates

The golden path joins the catalog and the declaration: it creates the repository with both files, the CI and the agent's context

What it creates

  • Repo: catalog-info.yaml + app-spec.yaml
  • Build: CI to the registry
  • Agent: AGENTS.md
Golden paths · Golden paths · o que ele cria

O golden path junta catálogo e declaração: cria o repo já com os dois arquivos, a CI e o contexto do agente

O que ele cria

  • Repo: catalog-info.yaml + app-spec.yaml
  • Build: CI até o registry
  • Agente: AGENTS.md
Golden Paths · Golden Paths · what it creates, an exampleidea

The next Nereid is born from the nereid-python template, and one apply registers it in the catalog next to Triton

Golden paths · Golden paths · o que ele cria, um exemploideia

O próximo Nereid nasce do template nereid-python, e um apply o registra no catálogo ao lado do Triton

~/git/nereus
# The golden path: the edge-cloudflare Nereid from the nereid-python template (a Template of the catalog, an idea)$ nereus template render nereid-python \    --path controllers/edge-cloudflare/ \    --param name=edge-cloudflare✓ catalog/templates/nereid-python rendered at controllers/edge-cloudflare/ (15 files, catalog/workloads/edge-cloudflare.yaml written) # Register what the repository says it has: the new entry, and Triton already imported$ nereus catalog apply \    --from-file catalog/✓ catalog/workloads/edge-cloudflare created (owner: Project/nereids, type: controller)  catalog/workloads/triton unchanged (owner: Project/triton, type: service) Next steps:   nereus catalog check

Backstage Software Catalog: system model, FAQ and life of an entity

Backstage documentation

  • About: The documentation of the Backstage software catalog: the entities (Component, API, Resource, System, Domain, Group), why the catalog does not hold versions, and how a file enters the catalog.
  • For this talk: "We do not recommend trying to represent fine grained versions in the catalog." The catalog holds "the human concept of a thing".
Referências · 1/4

Backstage Software Catalog: system model, FAQ and life of an entity

Backstage documentation

  • Sobre: A documentação do catálogo de software do Backstage: as entidades (Component, API, Resource, System, Domain, Group), por que o catálogo não guarda versões e como um arquivo entra no catálogo.
  • Para esta palestra: "We do not recommend trying to represent fine grained versions in the catalog." O catálogo guarda "the human concept of a thing".

https://backstage.io/docs/features/software-catalog/system-model#ecosystem-modeling

References · 2/4

Score specification reference

Score documentation

  • About: A platform- and environment-independent workload spec (apiVersion score.dev/v1b1): the developer describes what the app needs, the platform decides how and where.
  • For this talk: Its sections (metadata, containers, service, resources) are the model of the app declaration on these slides; resources are asked for by type, never by cloud service.
Referências · 2/4

Score specification reference

Score documentation

  • Sobre: Uma especificação de workload independente de plataforma e de ambiente (apiVersion score.dev/v1b1): o dev descreve o que a app precisa, e a plataforma decide como e onde.
  • Para esta palestra: As suas seções (metadata, containers, service, resources) são o modelo da declaração da app nestes slides; os recursos são pedidos por tipo, nunca por serviço de nuvem.

https://docs.score.dev/docs/score-specification/score-spec-reference/

References · 3/4

The Platform Engineering Illusion

David Iyanu Jonathan · 2026

  • About: An opinion piece: internal developer platforms fail because they are run as tooling initiatives when they are a product discipline.
  • For this talk: "Why would a developer, mid-deadline, exhausted, half paying attention, choose your paved road over the goat trail they already know?" Its figures are the author's own account and stay off the screen.
Referências · 3/4

The Platform Engineering Illusion

David Iyanu Jonathan · 2026

  • Sobre: Um artigo de opinião: as plataformas internas falham porque são tocadas como iniciativas de ferramentas quando são uma disciplina de produto.
  • Para esta palestra: "Why would a developer, mid-deadline, exhausted, half paying attention, choose your paved road over the goat trail they already know?" Os números são o relato do próprio autor e ficam fora da tela.

https://platformengineering.com/features/the-platform-engineering-illusion-why-most-internal-developer-platforms-fail-before-developers-ever-use-them/

References · 4/4

Platform as a Product

Abby Bangser, Daniel Bryant, Colin Humphreys and Cat Morris · 2025

  • About: An O'Reilly report: a platform is a product, with users, a value proposition, a feedback loop and a focus on adoption, not an infrastructure project with a delivery date.
  • For this talk: "abstractions should be composable and optional. They should guide without constraining." (p. 11), and the golden cage: a rigid, top-down golden path breeds shadow platforms. The four authors work for Syntasso, the company behind Kratix.
Referências · 4/4

Platform as a Product

Abby Bangser, Daniel Bryant, Colin Humphreys and Cat Morris · 2025

  • Sobre: Um relatório da O'Reilly: plataforma é produto, com usuários, proposta de valor, ciclo de feedback e foco em adoção, não um projeto de infraestrutura com data de entrega.
  • Para esta palestra: "abstractions should be composable and optional. They should guide without constraining." (p. 11), e a golden cage: um golden path rígido, imposto de cima, gera shadow platforms. Os quatro autores trabalham na Syntasso, a empresa por trás do Kratix.

https://www.syntasso.io/platform-as-a-product-oreilly-report
